plan.name: session_adaptation
plan.study_status: exploratory continuation on a previously inspected dataset
plan.source_model_requirement: fixed PhysioNet-only source probabilities; no BNCI refitting
plan.support_rule: first chronological left/right trials in session T; same identities for all methods at a budget
plan.donor_selection_rule: exclude the outer person's entire T and E; choose each method's C by mean balanced accuracy then log loss then smaller C on the other eight people's session-T later runs
plan.donor_validation_rule: for each budget use its first n T trials as pseudo-support and only T runs strictly after the last support run as validation; at budget144 use n96 for parameter selection because no later T run remains
plan.single_class_support_rule: retain source for anchored methods; target-only methods use the support-class prior; do not look ahead or discard a person
plan.fusion_rule: donor-selected convex average of intercept-adapted source and equal mean of FBCSP, tangent RBF SVM and anchored dual; the weight is selected without the outer person's data
plan.evaluation_rule: all 144 session-E left/right trials for every person and method; E labels are used for reporting only, never method, budget, C or fusion selection
